about: Batch 7 (3 Nov 2026, the owner: 'we need to focus on improving our BFSP model. The final price / log of final price is key'). Ranked first by RMSE of log(BSP) against the baseline. Batch 6's best (every new engine block and the race simulator, all_new_sim) against core; the same rescaled to the SP book's usual total (the closing study: the mid's RMSE 0.635 -> 0.492 so); larger trees; fewer features a tree. In the slow lane, the closing-price study (research/greyhound/bfsp_close.py) on core's and on the best's prices: how much a better pre-race price sharpens the forecast of log(BSP) from the book (our price is a fifth of the closing trees' gain).
